main.node: Code - Filter and Map Evergreen Leads

credentialIds.MAUTIC_OAUTH2_CRED_ID: Replace with your Mautic OAuth2 credential ID in n8n

_setupNotes.logic: Daily at 08:00: Finds all leads where activation phase is complete (>23 days since registration) and ac_nurture_stopped is not true. Adds them to ac-nurture-evergreen segment and increments ac_evergreen_position. Mautic campaign reads position and sends the correct evergreen email. Never repeats: position advances each time.
_setupNotes.mauticFields: Reads: ac_nurture_stopped, ac_last_form_submitted_at, ac_evergreen_position, ac_last_profile, ac_last_form_language. Writes: ac_evergreen_position (+1).
_setupNotes.mauticSegments: Must have segment: ac-nurture-evergreen created before activating
_setupNotes.scalingNote: For >500 contacts, add pagination loop over Mautic API (start parameter)
